_comment: Tracked streamdb dual-profile performance baseline. Produced by scripts/streamdb-perf-benchmark.sh from crates/pillar-streamdb/tests/perf_benchmark.rs on a debug build (offline `cargo test` sandbox). PUBLIC is the unencrypted throughput/latency CEILING and fixed baseline; CELL-ENCRYPTED is the guaranteed-confidentiality profile; op_delta_us is the first-class AEAD seal-overhead metric (encrypted - public, per op, microseconds). Numbers are debug-build and machine-relative, so the harness compares against a generous regression tolerance rather than an exact match: a run REGRESSES only when a latency metric exceeds baseline * (1 + tolerance). A future tuning task SHRINKS op_delta_us within the safety envelope and lowers these numbers (re-record the baseline in the same commit).
